# bookmatch — quality and operations for the UCSD-corpus recommendation service

> [!warning] **At a glance:** healthy when `/api/health` reports `ok` and `corpus_ready`; the deploy gate enforces this before and after every restart.

## Behavioral contracts

- **deploys are never silent** — `deploy.sh` aborts non-zero on a dirty tree, a failed restart, or a dead `/api/health`; a rollback still exits non-zero.
- **a failed health check never leaves the service on bad code** — `deploy.sh` rolls back to the last known-good revision and records it in `.deploy-last-good`.
- **the index is always reproducible** — `scripts/build_index.py` is idempotent and rewrites the index directory on each run.
- **the test gate is never bypassed by a fresh clone** — `scripts/install_hooks.sh` must run once per clone to activate the ADR-0020 pre-push gate; without it, pushes silently skip the gate.

## Health

The aliveness signal is `/api/health`, polled by `deploy.sh` after every restart. The endpoint must report both `ok` and `corpus_ready` for the deploy to succeed.

A FAILURE is a non-zero exit from `deploy.sh` — a dirty tree, a failed `sudo -n systemctl restart`, or a `/api/health` that does not report `ok` and `corpus_ready`. A QUIET state is a healthy service with no recent requests — the corpus is built, the index is present, and the endpoint responds, but no analysis has been requested. The two are never conflated: health is a live probe, not an activity counter.

## Policies & SLAs

| name | value | source config |
|---|---|---|
| deploy health gate | `ok` and `corpus_ready` from `/api/health` | `deploy.sh` |
| rollback trigger | health check failure after restart | `deploy.sh` |
| last-good marker | `.deploy-last-good` | `deploy.sh` |
| test gate | pre-push, ADR-0020 | `.githooks/` + `scripts/install_hooks.sh` |

## Tests

The suite is run by the pre-push hook (ADR-0020) and by CI on push/PR. The exact test count is UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).

The suite does NOT cover the live deploy path — `deploy.sh` is exercised only by running it against aurora.

## Deploy & operate

Ship path: push to `main` → pre-push test gate (ADR-0020) → `./deploy.sh` on aurora. The script refuses a dirty tree, restarts the unit with `sudo -n systemctl restart`, polls `/api/health` for `ok` and `corpus_ready`, and records the deployed revision in `.deploy-last-good` on success.

Restart command: `sudo -n systemctl restart bookmatch.service` (via `deploy.sh`).

Rollback: if health checks fail, `deploy.sh` rolls back to the last known-good revision from `.deploy-last-good`. The script exits non-zero even after a successful rollback, marking the deploy as failed.
